Because a structural test passes, that structural modality is PRIMARY (§B.7a clause 1; §B.7: a structural pass beats residual recognition), so primary_modality = currency-shadow-price, NOT recognition-landing. The structural-currency price needs a NAMED principle to fix its thermodynamic meaning, so the edge lands at the (currency-shadow-price, E2) cell of §B.8. The named import -- QFT in curved spacetime (Hawking thermal flux) + the first law of black-hole mechanics, under the semiclassical no-back-reaction assumption (= the E034 construction) -- is recorded as a SECONDARY recognition-conditional flag (§B.7a clause 3), enforced in parallel by check C13 (NOT C11, since the PRIMARY modality is structural, not recognition-landing). No-over-read E.3 PASSES for the conditional landing (recovered T,S, first-law-thermo are in the target's accepted_observables; the microscopic S=A/4G state-counting is explicitly NOT claimed). DETERMINISTIC OUTCOME: primary_modality = currency-shadow-price (structural beats residual recognition), tier = E2 (unchanged), secondary = recognition-conditional. NEVER summed with E1, NOT a derivation. (Contrast E022, the opposite-arrow thermo->GR recovery, which IS a primary recognition-landing because no structural GR test closes it and Jacobson's 'Einstein equation of state' is the entire landing mechanism.)
